offerings.name: Web Search API
offerings.pricing: Free: 1,000 credits/month; Hobby: $16/month (yearly) for 5,000 credits/month; Standard: $83/month (yearly) for 100,000 credits/month; Growth: $333/month (yearly) for 500,000 credits/month; Scale: $599/month (yearly) for 1,000,000 credits/month; Search costs 2 credits per 10 results (rounded up); PAYG adds $5 increments yielding 1,000/2,000/2,500/5,000 extra credits by plan.
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits every month, refreshed monthly, no credit card required.
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（web/news/images：标题、描述、URL 等），可选通过 scrapeOptions 抓取全文 markdown/HTML/links/screenshots
offerings.note: gov category 不收 search credits；ZDR anon 计 2 credits/10 results，end-to-end ZDR 计 10 credits/10 results；可选抓取按每页计费。
